_comment: backlog row 185. Re-run from a DETACHED clone with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/<this file> --work /tmp/<clone> -- and note the clone needs `npm ci` in frontend/, because every catcher delegates to Vitest. VALIDITY CAVEAT: bd-mutate ast.parse-validates only .py and shellchecks .sh; a .tsx/.ts mutant falls through UNVALIDATED, so a malformed anchor would present as CAUGHT via an esbuild transform error rather than a real catch. Each mutant below was hand-replayed on a scratch copy of cef6eb4 and failed on a SEMANTIC assertion message, never a transform error -- that is the validity evidence. All six share one pytest nodeid because the gate delegates to Vitest, so the catching VITEST test is named inside each label. MEASURED AGAINST THE RETIRED TEXT SCAN: M1, M2 and M5 left the old six-assertion scan fully green; M3, M4 and M6 it caught textually.
subject: the /cluster route's runtime write-gating contract: no gated write fires from a single interaction, sync_pull cannot auto-fire on mount/focus/interval, the two A-tier writes are No-default confirmed, and the pairing token is a write-only secret cleared only on success
